notes: Fixes a Backtest inconsistency: the 'SL at swing' setting for Breakout Trendline could be switched off with no visible sign anything changed, and doing so measurably hurt results (profit factor 1.46 down to 0.63 on identical data in testing). It is now always on, matching the setting that performed better. Five other toggles that had no effect (they were already fixed automatically) have been removed from the screen so there is nothing left to accidentally change. Every Backtest result now also states exactly which settings it used, at the bottom of the result and in the activity log, so results are always traceable to what was actually tested.
